title: Editorial Intent
description: The structured result of natural-language intake (AES-V2.1 / SUE-559) expressed over five independent axes (AES-V2.2 / SUE-560). A human writes sentences; an agent writes this. Every axis value carries a resolution state, and only `confirmed` values may ever inform durable calibration.

intent_id.description: Stable id for this intake. Lineage anchor: every downstream frame, plan, artifact, and feedback record cites it.

request.description: What the human actually said, kept verbatim. The intake is auditable only if the utterance survives next to its interpretation.

language.description: BCP-47 language of the request itself. Not the output language — that is constraints.output_language.

received_by.description: Agent runtime that performed intake, e.g. `claude-code`, `chatgpt`. Recorded so an intake defect can be attributed.

axes.description: The five independent axes. They do not collapse into one another: a transformation is not a content type, a surface is not an audience, an artifact is not a style.

artifacts.description: One or more requested artifacts. Empty means the artifact axis is still unresolved and must appear in clarification.required.

inputs.description: Source and Reference are separate lists because they are separate kinds of authority. A reference can never establish a fact; a source can never dictate a composition.

max_source_age_days.description: Freshness ceiling when the request is time-sensitive. Absent means the content-type profile decides.

overrides.description: Values the human set for THIS RUN only. Task-scoped by construction — an override is never durable preference, and V2.10 calibration may not read this array.

clarification.description: The exception path. Questions are asked only when a missing field would materially change thesis, audience fit, transformation fidelity, artifact route, publication constraint, or cost.

required.description: Axis or constraint paths currently in state `missing_material`. Non-empty forces status `blocked_on_clarification`.

asked.description: Normally 0-3 entries. An intake that asks four or more questions has failed its own gate and must record why in `note`.

resolution.description: proceeded: nothing material was missing. answered: the human supplied the missing values. default_authorized: the human said `알아서 해` / `use default`, which authorizes `assumed` for this run and nothing beyond it. unresolved: still blocked.

calibration_ref.description: The calibration version active at intake (AES-V2.10). Recorded so a later verdict can be attributed to the calibration that produced it rather than to whichever is current.

status.description: ready: the intent may drive framing/planning. blocked_on_clarification: at least one material field is unresolved. declined: intake refused the request and recorded why in clarification.note.

resolution_state.description: confirmed: the human said it, or an authoritative upstream contract did — the only state that may inform durable calibration. assumed: safely inferred for this run; never durable preference evidence. missing_material: absent and materially outcome-changing.

value.description: Profile id within the matching axis directory under editorial/profiles/. null only when state is missing_material.

profile_ref.description: Repository path of the resolved profile. Absent when unresolved.

basis.description: Why this value. For `confirmed`, the span of the utterance or the upstream contract that fixed it. For `assumed`, the inference. Required in practice for audit; a value with no basis cannot be routed when it turns out wrong.

audience_axis.description: Audience is the one axis shared by every modality: it changes explanation depth in text, information density in visuals, and pace and assumed knowledge in audio. A preset plus task-specific trait overrides, never a rigid bucket.

traits.description: Task-specific deviations from the preset. Only traits that materially change delivery belong here — demographics that change nothing are ceremonial and are omitted.

life_stage.description: Recorded only when it materially affects communication — a child audience changes vocabulary and example choice; an age number that changes nothing does not belong here.

value.description: Artifact profile id, namespaced by modality: `text/article`, `visual/body-infographic`, `audio/dialogue`. The modality prefix is what keeps text, visual, and audio generation contracts separate.

source_input.description: Material that can establish fact. Referenced by id and never copied into this repository.

reference_input.description: Material that can inform craft. Carries no factual authority: an evaluation of a reference may never become a verified claim.

dimensions.description: Which dimensions of this reference the human actually wants applied. `이 reference는 정보 구조는 좋은데 색감은 싫어` becomes dimensions plus a task override, not wholesale imitation.

options.description: Choices with a marked default beat an open prompt. A clarification with no options is a defect unless the field genuinely has an open range.
